TIME TABLE REFERENCES
The 24-Hour Clock is Used in This Time Table. Times shown between 00:01 (1 minute after mid-
night) and 12:00 (noon) are A.M. Times shown from 12:01 to 24:00 are P.M. To convert P.M. times
to 12-hour clock, subtract 12 hours.
•No local passengers carried between adjacent stations marked with this symbol. However, stop-
overs allowed on through tickets.
f-Flag stop.
*Principal junction point.
PST-Pacific Standard Time (120th Meridian).
A.S.S.Co.-Alaska S. S. Co.
All other times are shown in degrees west of Greenwich (zero Meridian). 15 degrees difference in
longitude equals 1 hour change in time.
r-Lockheed Electra Land Planes.
g-Pilgrim Land Planes.
